case_title: KATO TOMOMI VS UCSF ( ACCT. RECEIVABLE)

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $404.00 FILED BY KATO TOMOMI AS TO DEFENDANT UCSF ( ACCT. RECEIVABLE) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-21-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT UCSF ( ACCT. RECEIVABLE)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KATO TOMOMI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT UCSF ( ACCT. RECEIVABLE) THE BILL WHILE HIGH WAS NOT SHOWN BY PLAINTIFF TO EXCEED THE CUSTOMARY & REASONABLE SERVICE FEE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
